system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Members of the Konjiki clan are able to utilize the malleability of their chakra, infusing it into metal, bending and twisting it into a liquid-like substance, capable of reclaiming a solid shape at the Konjiki’s pleasure. At the conclusion of a Short or long rest, the Konjiki can choose to create a Metallurgy Armor or coat a weapon they wield in Metallurgy itself, that lasts until they complete their next rest.

If a weapon, they select a single weapon they have in their possession to become coated in Metallurgy. If the weapon chosen has the Ammunition trait, treat the ammunition die as a d12 that can never be reduced in size by an effect that would call for it. The weapon gains a unique Konjiki weapon property from the following list.

Beginning at 11th level, you can create one of each an Armor and weapon.

Geometric Makeup. The Weapon grants you with a solid offense and defense with its dense structure, gaining the Fortified and Blocking 1 traits.

Counter weight. The weapon cannot be disarmed from you and gains the thrown (20/40) and Return keywords.

Shearing Edge. Once per turn, on a hit, you may reduce an affected creatures AC by 1, or their DR by 2, until the beginning of your next turn.

| #### Mercury Foundry / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / You generate +1 Ingot at the beginning of each of your turns. / You DR is set at 12. If your DR is instead higher than 12, increase your DR by +2. / At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain 8 Temporary hit points. / Weapons made by your Liquid Metal trait, or under the effects of your Metallurgy clan feature, count as any weapon group, for the purposes of casting Bukijutsu. / Armor made by Metallurgy can gain a second trait. |

Rebounding Line. Once per turn, if your attack using this weapon (Weapon attack or Taijutsu attack) result would be 5 or higher than the targets AC, the next attack targeting you before the beginning of your next turn is made at disadvantage.

If armor, select one Armor from the following: Reinforced Cloth, Shinobi Combat Jacket or Jonin Armor. The armor can be in any design of your choice, has a Bulk of 1 and gains a Konjiki unique armor property from the following list:

Anchored Greaves. You have Advantage on saves to resist being moved against your will. On a successful save against such an effect, you gain 1 Liquid Metal Ingot.

Elemental Deflection Plates. Select one elemental damage type (Earth, Wind, Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid). You have resistance to the given damage type until you are hit by a critical hit or create another weapon or armor with this feature.

Expanding Plates. All other creatures within 5 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to their AC.

Smart Armor. While wearing this armor, you can use Intelligence, in place of Dexterity for armor class calculation and 60 feet of tremor sense.

Kinetic Raiment. Once per turn, when you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you gain a bonus to the damage you deal equal to twice your Reinforced value. When you use this effect, you gain 1 Liquid Metal Ingot.
